install.notes: The upstream repository ships no licence file, so the card's NOASSERTION/unknown is pinned as it is. pip install . installs the upstream plb package, which needs Taichi, the legacy gym package, numpy and a GPU (ti.init(arch=ti.gpu) at plb/engine/taichi_env.py:6). The gate and the fake backend need none of this: fake.py is pure Python, and the gate never installs or imports the clone. Install the upstream only to serve the sim backend, which was not run.
